messages:
elena (release): ok team — planning a serial delivery for the private installer to the three VPC customers tomorrow 0200-0400 UTC. strategy: escorted manifest, single-customer canary, 30m hold, then parallel pushes if green. will pin to v1.8.2-build.7 :calendar:
jason (packaging): uploading signed artefacts now. building shrinkwrap delta for v1.8.2 -> v1.8.3-lite. expecting ~420MB per bundle.
deploy-bot: build 1.8.3-lite completed: artifacts/installer-v1.8.3-lite.tar.gz (sha256: 9f3a...b8c1). cosign signature: cosign:sha256:abcd1234. signer: projects/redwood-kms/key-prod-01
aimee (sec): +1 on signatures. confirm KMS rotation window is outside the change window. we validated offline verifier against the manifest.
marc (onprem): request: do the canary on the cluster with low-req tenant (cust-id: C-091) not the staging mirror. production-like environment needed to surface storage path issues.
elena (release): yes canary to C-091 only. if any failures we abort and roll back to v1.8.2-build.7. rollback playbook: revert manifest pin, push delta-revert, and run deploy-bot abort hook.
sam (cust-succ): FYI C-091 is in APAC (UTC+10) — monitor their local biz hours. they'd prefer pre-midnight maintenance. can we shift window to 2300-0100 UTC? that hits our US ops late though.
jason (packaging): shifting to 2300-0100 ok for me. repackaging ETA 25m. updating manifest with new timestamp and transport-escrow id.
ops-bot: reserving transport window 1762572000-1762579200 (2300-0100 UTC). note: network egress quota checks scheduled at -2h.
elena (release): include the following deliver checks in manifest: checksum, cosign sig, kustomize overlay hash, transport escort ID, customer ack flag.

jason (packaging): manifest snippet:
```
- customer: C-091
  version: v1.8.3-lite
  artifact: installer-v1.8.3-lite.tar.gz
  sha256: 9f3a7b2e...b8c1
  cosign: cosign:sha256:abcd1234
  escort_id: escort-2026-03-20-01
```

jason (packaging): pushing manifest to secret transport bucket (sealed). ETA upload 8m.

aimee (sec): quick checklist: 1) cosign verified 2) manifest sealed 3) transport signed by escort key 4) no outgoing env creds in package. I'm running the verifier now.

aimee (sec): verifier log: "manifest OK, cosign OK, installer binary linked libs OK". :white_check_mark:
marc (onprem): prepping canary cluster snapshot + rollback image pinned as v1.8.2-build.7. I will enable extra logging on the install agent for the first 15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy -> customer:C-091, window start=1762575600. hook: preflight -> run healthcheck script -> stop on failure.

jason (packaging): upload complete. transport meta: escort-manifest.json sealed at 2026-03-20T22:54Z. copy command:
```
gsutil cp installer-v1.8.3-lite.tar.gz gs://sealed-transit/escort-2026-03-20-01/
```

elena (release): reminder: rollback kill-switch is `deploy-bot abort ${thread_ts}` and devex will have the shortcut on the runbook. if we abort, we notify customers and open a Support incident with SLA tag.
sam (cust-succ): acknowledged. I'll ping C-091 pre-maint and keep a bridge open during the canary.
marc (onprem): canary smoke started. agent logs:
```
[00:02] fetch artifact OK
[00:04] verify cosign OK
[00:07] unpack OK
[00:09] install svc start -> WARN: kube-probe timed out for sidecar
```
marc (onprem): hitting that kube-probe timeout on one node. rolling back canary now per playbook.
elena (release): OK aborting. deploy-bot abort 1762509999

deploy-bot: ABORTED by elena (release). reason: kube-probe timeout on canary. initiating rollback to v1.8.2-build.7. rollback actions:
- unpin manifest -> pin v1.8.2-build.7
- push delta-revert to C-091
- run post-rollback healthcheck

jason (packaging): pushing delta-revert artifact now (sha256: e2c1...777a). ETA 3m.
ops-bot: rollback network egress: cleared. scheduled post-rollback checks in 10m.
aimee (sec): postmortem trigger: please capture installer debug tarball and cosign audit for the canary. I'll open an internal security ticket.
marc (onprem): revert apply done. healthchecks passing on C-091 now.

elena (release): good work team. next steps: 1) root cause on kube-probe timeout (env/perf) 2) iterate on smaller installer probe timeouts for canaries 3) re-run canary after fix, do not expand until +2h stable.

sam (cust-succ): updated C-091 with rollback done. customer saw brief apps restart, no data loss.
elena (release): I'll update the release notes: add canary abort, pinned back to v1.8.2-build.7, follow-up PR for probe timeout. tagging this thread in the release board.

deploy-bot: thread closed by elena (release).
